title: reconcile B1/B2 report+audit client contracts to real A7 DTOs

notes: Each B7a ASSUMED mismatch fixed against the REAL laneA7 records (read in api/src/Taxi.Api/Features/{Reports,Audit}). (1) DAY FIELD: per-day + chart day field is `date` (not `day`); ridesPerDay is {date,count} (not {day,rides}) — fixed DriverReportTable, ridesChartGeometry (RidesPerDayPoint/ChartBar now date/count), RidesChart (feeds bar.date/bar.count into the unchanged {{day}}/{{rides}} barLabel placeholders to avoid i18n churn), and formatDay still splits real dates (totals row uses i18n totalsRow, never formatDay). (2) MONEY NAMES: per-day/ totals use cashCzk/cardCzk/invoiceCzk/totalCzk/hoursOnline/priceOverrideCount + ridesCompleted/ridesCancelled — fixed the table + reportTotals.sumDays. STRUCTURAL FIX the task didn't spell out (advisor-caught): GetDriverReportResponse is {driverId,driverName,avgRating(TOP-LEVEL),days,totals} and `totals` is a DriverReportDayDto with date='Celkem' (NO separate TotalsDto, NO avgRating inside totals) — deleted the invented DriverReportTotalsDto, added driverId/driverName/top-level avgRating to the client type. (3) RATINGS ENVELOPE: real is { items } (NOT { ratings }) and RANGELESS — getRatings()/useRatings() drop the from/to args; RatingDto is {orderPublicCode,driverName(nullable),stars,comment,ratedAt}; RatingsList reads orderPublicCode + driverName ?? '—'. (4) FLEET KPI: appOrders/phoneOrders/fixedRouteOrders/rides are RAW COUNTS — FleetKpiCards now derives appShare = appOrders/(appOrders+phoneOrders) and fixedRouteShare = fixedRouteOrders/rides with a div-by-zero guard (-> '—'); cancellationRate stays 0..1 rendered as %; avgTimeToAssignSeconds/avgTimeToPickupSeconds are nullable seconds -> formatDuration(null) returns '—'. (5) AUDIT PAGING BASE: CONFIRMED 1-BASED in api (GetAuditRequest.Page=1 default, PageSize=50 default, Skip((Page-1)*PageSize); GetAuditResponse doc 'The 1-based page number'). AuditPage state is now 1-based (initial page 1), audit.page shows `page` (not page+1), hasNext = serverPage*serverPageSize < total using the response's page+pageSize (NOT a hardcoded 50); AuditResponse type gained pageSize; request does NOT send pageSize (lets the server default). item.event->item.action, item.actor->item.actorUserId (shown ?? '—'). (6) AUDIT ACTION STRING: the ONLY audit_log writer is OverrideStatusEndpoint with Action='StatusOverride' (singular), Entity='Driver' — remapped auditEventLabel (ASSUMED_AUDIT_ACTIONS['StatusOverridden','DriverStatusOverridden'] -> KNOWN_AUDIT_ACTIONS['StatusOverride']) and collapsed the two i18n audit.event keys into one 'StatusOverride' in BOTH cs.json + en.json (parity test green). ENVELOPES THAT MATCHED: getFleetReport {kpis,ridesPerDay,topRoutes}, getAudit {items,total,page(,pageSize added)}. EXTRA FINDING beyond the six (advisor-flagged, fixed minimally): GetDriverReport validator requires DriverId NotEmpty -> Guid.Empty/empty selection = 400; B7a defaulted driverId to '' ('Všichni řidiči') which would show a permanent error banner on every load. Gated useDriverReport with an `enabled` flag (enabled only when driverId !== ''); the driver section shows a new reports.driverReport.selectDriver hint (added to both locales) until a driver is picked. DID NOT touch GetDriverMySummaryResponse / driver historyTotals (they legitimately use cashTotalCzk/cardTotalCzk/invoiceTotalCzk — only the REPORT DTOs get the *Czk names). No api/** touched. KNOWN LIMITATION (pre-existing B7a, outside the six, NOT fixed): the audit `actor` filter is a free-text <Input> but the backend param is Guid? — empty (the default) is fine and the actor column correctly shows actorUserId ?? '—' (a raw Guid, the honest consequence of the DTO dropping the role label), but typing a non-Guid name + Filtrovat yields actor=<text> -> Guid bind failure -> 400 -> error banner. Flagged for the reviewer; a future polish would make it a driver/user picker. Added a ReportsPage test asserting a null avg-time KPI + zero-denominator share render '—' and never 'NaN' (locks the highest-risk NaN branch).
